notablePrerequisites: Karn has at least three loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from exile to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Tormod's Crypt from exile to your hand.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Karn.
Repeat.
